name: @thurinlabs/thurin
description: Thurin from a terminal: look up, attest, update, and revoke on-chain PGP identities. Never a wallet; never holds a PGP secret.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const d=require('./package.json'); if (Object.keys(d.dependencies||{}).length) { console.error('Refusing to publish with runtime dependencies: the CLI ships as one bundled file'); process.exit(1) } if (d.devDependencies['@thurinlabs/identity-kit'].startsWith('file:')) { console.error('Refusing to publish with identity-kit linked from a path; set it to a published version (^2.0.0)'); process.exit(1) }" && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
